messages:
ana_support: FYI — customer (acme-inc) reporting weird negative tokens/sec spikes and long holes in the streaming TTFT panel since the canary deploy at ~02:10 UTC. Grafana shows -1k to -2k for tokens/sec then entire intervals with no datapoints :sos:

mike_eng: :eyes: any request ids or traces? did they hit hosted or dedicated?

ana_support: Hosted (region-us). They sent a trace id: trace-0a3b. Customer repro steps: 1) start streaming request; 2) watch tokens/sec on the 'streaming TTFT' panel; 3) observe negative values or blanks after ~02:15.

linh_obs: I pulled the panel's raw query. It aggregates from metrics-streaming.* -> stream-metrics-agg topic. Query returned points like: `{ "timestamp": 1710000000, "tokens_rate": -1240.5 }` and a series of nulls for the next 3 windows.

josh_sre: Did the deploy at 02:10 include ingest-agg v2.9.0? deploy-bot: `deploy: stream-metrics-agg v2.9.0 -> prod-canary @ 2026-03-16T02:10Z`

mike_eng: Yep that rollout included the new 'delta-accum optimization' for lower memory. Suspect accumulation overflow/underflow when window boundaries cross partition offsets.

ana_support: Customer also saw API 502 briefly at 02:12 but most of the errors were fine; main customer impact is dashboard confusing them and billing appears unaffected so far (customer asked if billing could show negative).

billing-bot: `billing-notify: No negative invoice adjustments detected for acme-inc. Token counters derived from usage-db (separate pipeline).`

linh_obs: Quick repro I did: `curl -s "https://metrics-api.redwood/api/v1/streaming?start=2026-03-16T02:14:00Z&end=2026-03-16T02:20:00Z" | jq '.data[0].tokens_rate'` -> `-980.0` (reproducible from our metrics-api cluster).

mike_eng: Dumping aggregator log snippet for stream-metrics-agg container (02:14 UTC):
```
{"level":"info","ts":"2026-03-16T02:14:01Z","service":"stream-metrics-agg","window_ms":1000,"tokens_delta":-1234.0,"partitions":"p3","agg_state":"reduced"}
{"level":"warn","ts":"2026-03-16T02:14:02Z","msg":"negative accumulation detected","ctx":{"offset_range":"1001-1005","window_id":12501}}
```

josh_sre: That warn log lines up. Likely a bug in the delta-accum where we subtract previous checkpointed counter but previous was misread (race with commit). Could be an ordering issue with Kafka offsets + checkpoint store (sled DB).

ana_support: Customer asked for workaround — any safe mitigations before we rollback?

mike_eng: Short-term: clamp tokens_rate >= 0 at dashboard query layer. I can push a patch to Grafana transform or add a Prometheus recording rule in the metrics-api to `max(tokens_rate,0)`. That avoids scary negatives in UI. Longer term we should rollback v2.9.0 for canary and pause full rollout.

linh_obs: I can apply the clamp on the metrics-api side (quick) — but that hides the root cause. Also creating an alert so SRE knows if we see negative values again.

josh_sre: Create an alert + page if negative tokens_rate > 0 for any aggregation window over 5m. I'll own the page.

mike_eng: I'll prepare rollback PR: `stream-metrics-agg 2.9.0 -> 2.8.3` and run canary to validate. ETA 30m.

ana_support: I told customer: "we're investigating, temporary dashboard clamp is being applied; engineering triaging rollback. Will update in ~30m." They responded :thumbsup:.

alex_pm: Logging RI ticket and tagging owners. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-2027 — brief: streaming agg negative accumulation after delta-accum optimization. Add postmortem and plan for better offset checkpoint tests.

linh_obs: Action items: 1) apply clamp in metrics-api (linh) 2) rollback canary if clamp shows zeros instead of negatives (mike) 3) alert + page (josh) 4) full root-cause investigation + unit tests around checkpoint ordering (mike + eng).

deploy-bot: `action: metrics-api patch applied to prod @ 2026-03-16T03:05Z (clamp max(tokens_rate,0))`

mike_eng: Rollback performed for canary at 03:25Z, monitoring now. Initial observation: negatives gone in canary cluster, dedicated clusters still rolling?

linh_obs: Dashboard now shows zeros where negatives were. I pushed alert rule. `ALERT StreamingNegativeRate WHEN tokens_rate < 0 FOR 1m` (firing count = 0).

ana_support: Customer confirmed panel looks normal now and appreciates the quick fix. Marking as escalated resolved for now, will keep ticket open for root cause.

alex_pm: Nice work. Please follow up with a short postmortem and a regression test in CI for aggregator checkpoint semantics.

mike_eng: Will do — will attach logs/traces and timeline to RI-2027.
